summary.name: Rask AI
summary.one_liner: Rask AI is an AI video dubbing, translation, and localization tool with an in-app editor and API, supporting 135+ languages.
use_cases: Automating bulk audio and video translation via API
Cutting pauses and cleaning up screen recordings
summary.what_it_does: Rask dubs and translates video and audio into 135+ languages, with some features such as voice-based dubbing available in 32+ languages. It can transcribe and translate YouTube videos and supports lip-sync on translated videos, with inputs up to 5 hours long. It can automatically generate and add captions, and detect the number of speakers in a video. It also offers a translation database to keep preferred translations consistent, saved settings that can be applied in one click, team workspaces, and file organization for large projects. A product video creator can cut pauses, clean voices, and zoom into screen recordings.
notable: Lip-sync and voice dubbing across 135+ languages, with voice cloning in 32+ languages
Public API for automating translation of large volumes of audio and video
SOC 2 Type II certified and C2PA member
Translation memory database and team workspaces
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Videos longer than 5 hours are not supported for transcription and lip-sync
Own-voice dubbing is limited to 32+ languages
